original_main_description:
Finish every wash with faster, easier drying. The dense 1200GSM dual-layer construction has strong water-holding capacity, lifting water from panels quickly for a streak-free finish with fewer passes—especially useful when drying larger vehicles.

Its thick, cushioned design combines serious absorbency with a soft, premium feel, helping reduce contact pressure on paintwork while drying.

Suitable for ceramic-coated and waxed cars, this heavy-duty towel brings dependable drying performance to your post-wash routine without unnecessary fuss.
corrected_main_description:
Finish every wash with faster, easier drying. The dense 1200GSM dual-layer construction has strong water-holding capacity, lifting water from panels quickly for a streak-free finish with fewer passes—especially useful when drying larger vehicles.

Its thick, cushioned design combines serious absorbency with a soft, premium feel, helping reduce contact pressure on paintwork while the 90 × 60 cm size balances coverage with control.

Suitable for cars, SUVs and vans, including paintwork, glass and exterior plastics, as well as ceramic-coated and waxed cars. Lay it flat, pat dry or glide it across the surface to make light work of post-wash drying.
